message.content: Sure! The most common machine for baking a chocolate cake is a conventional oven—just preheat it to the right temperature and bake the batter in a pan. If you’re looking for something quicker or more convenient, a microwave oven can also bake a small cake (though the texture will differ slightly), and a slow cooker can produce a moist, dense chocolate cake if you follow a slow‑cooker‑specific recipe.
